name: Warm Mineral Springs Park
coordinateNote: Entrance or parking coordinates from the November 12, 2026 gap review.
navigationDestination: Warm Mineral Springs Park, 12200 San Servando Ave, North Port, FL 34287
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Soak and swim in the open sinkhole basin year-round at 85 degrees; ropes mark where the deep water starts and lifeguards are on duty. It is 10 minutes off I-75 at North Port, an easy stop on the Miami-to-Crystal River drive. Scuba is banned because the site is an archaeological site.
cost: $20 per non-resident adult per day; $15 per student age 6-17; free under 6 (fees effective Oct 1, 2026)
access: Walk-in, 9 a.m.-5 p.m. daily, closed Thanksgiving and Christmas. Same-day re-entry allowed. No glass, alcohol, tents, umbrellas or scuba. Small coolers allowed. The historic building (showers, lockers, gift shop) is closed after hurricane damage; a temporary admissions building and portable restroom trailer are on site.

conditions.summary: Open daily 9-5 except Thursday Nov 26 (Thanksgiving). Historic bathhouse closed; temporary facilities only. Visit Sarasota reported construction underway as of June 2026. (source dated read 2026-11-12)

name: Lake Jackson campsites 1 and 2, Prairie Lakes Unit, Three Lakes Wildlife Management Area
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationDestination: Three Lakes Wildlife Management Area Prairie Lakes Unit, Kenansville, FL
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: The Prairie Lakes Unit has five family campsites and a group camp; Lake Jackson sites 1 and 2 have picnic tables, a grill and a vault toilet, while site 3, Dry Pond and Parker Hammock are hike-in only. Tents only, no RVs or trailers. A no-cost permit from the wildlife agency is required, and the sites close during quota hunts on the unit. The map point is OpenStreetMap's marker for Lake Jackson, not the campsite.
access: Free permit or reservation required before arrival. Stay limit: Not stated; a site left unattended more than five consecutive days may void the permit 'Camping on the Prairie Lakes Unit is not allowed during quota hunts'; the 2026-27 quota hunt dates were not obtained. Permit holders also need a management area permit or a daily-use permit for each day camped. The separate hunter campgrounds (441, 60, Canoe Creek) are open only during hunting periods.

conditions.summary: Open outside quota hunts; the quota hunt dates for late November and early December 2026 were not confirmed. (source dated read 2026-11-12)
